item.title: Goodstart offers free help to ECEC providers to guide teachers and educators to understand and respond to children’s sexual behaviours
item.description: As part of their normal development, very young children can display sexual curiosity and behaviours. To mark National Child Protection Week, Goodstart Early Learning, the largest ECEC provider in Australia, is sharing a guide to responding to children's sexual behaviour with other early learning centres, their teachers and educators.
